text:
Jordan: Heads-up — Zephyr Health asked for a FedRAMP-specific call today, they just pinged support. Can we pivot the 3pm enablement to cover compliance + data residency?
Priya: On it. Are they asking for a full deep-dive or just slides + Q&A?
Jordan: They want a quick demo + security Q&A, 45m max. Prefer earlier if possible (EMEA overlap).
Ethan: I can lead the demo but need a security SME for the 15m compliance section. Kai, can you join?
Kai: Yep, I can do 11:00–11:45 PT. 3pm is tight for my calendar.
Sam: I had a customer at 11 but can swap with Priya, she'll cover mine.
Priya: Confirmed — I can swap. Sam, can you take my 3pm check-in?
Sam: Yup, got it.
Jordan: Great — need to update the public calendar invite and the workshop agenda. Also: demo env needs a cleared dataset (PII scrubbed). @cs_scheduler_bot can you create a new invite for 11:00 PT and add "FedRAMP focus" in the title?
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ New invite: https://cal.redwood.com/event/zephyr-fedramp-1742109999 (11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC). Attendees updated.
Priya: Draft agenda below, please flag edits:
```
11:00 - 11:05 Intro + goals (Jordan)
11:05 - 11:25 Demo: inference pipeline & data controls (Ethan)
11:25 - 11:40 Compliance Q&A: FedRAMP, data residency, KMS (Kai)
11:40 - 11:45 Next steps & SWAT list (Priya)
```
Ethan: Need 2 extra minutes for the live demo hop — can shorten intros.
Jordan: Fine — adjust to 11:05 start time for demo then.
Sam: For the scrubbed dataset: runbook link is https://internal.redwood/runbooks/data-scrub. I can patch the sandbox now.
Kai: Also prep a 1-page FedRAMP checklist to drop in chat. I have one from last quarter.
Priya: I'll create a slide deck with the checklist + a one-slide migration matrix. Uploading to the event doc in 10m.
Jordan: Who's presenting the migration/runbook follow-up? We need an owner for post-call action items so renewal signals are captured.
Sam: I'll own the runbook follow-up and send the post-call notes + playbook.
Ethan: I'll record the demo and share timestamps for the demo clip.
Priya: Added the deck and updated agenda in the invite.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Priya. Email invites resent.
Jordan: Awesome. Final checks: Kai, can you be on standby 10:45–11:15 for pre-call sync?
Kai: Yes.
Jordan: Thanks all. I'll post the short pre-read in the thread and ping Zephyr's CISO contact.
Jordan: @Zephyr_CISO — quick note: we moved the session to 11:00 PT to accommodate your security team. See invite: https://cal.redwood.com/event/zephyr-fedramp-1742109999
Zephyr_CISO: (external) Thanks — confirmed, looking forward to the compliance portion.
Priya: Post-call: I'll run an enablement pulse survey (2 questions) and attach the score to the customer health doc.
Sam: I'll log any renewal concerns flagged in the call as "potential ops risk" if they ask about on-prem options.
Jordan: Perfect. We're set. :thumbsup:
Priya: One more — can someone double-check that Dedicated vs Hosted configuration slide is clear about isolation guarantees? Evan from Solutions asked earlier.
Ethan: I'll add an explicit bullet under the demo showing KMS/HSM options + network isolation.
Jordan: Thanks. See you on the quick pre-call at 10:45.
Priya: 10:45 sync created (DM).
cs_scheduler_bot: Reminder scheduled: 15m before event.
